world-islands-lakes.title: World, islands and lakes
world-islands-lakes.status: Two bounded source reviews are integrated: original97-case partition plus122 additional IDs (reports6566078651/6566081354 and6566275689/6566277162). Shared save/creature cases and owner-only listings are counted elsewhere once. No world runtime was executed. Six scenery declarations read in second house report 6566610514 are integrated here without duplicate membership.
world-islands-lakes.keepSummary: campaign identity and map equivalence, spatial boundaries, authored world content, resource budgets and explicit link/transition rules
protections: A campaign retains island shapes across nights while permitted creature/type deals change.
Walkers, landing and world objects respect water, coast and zoo-fence boundaries.
Rosters, biome blends, lake appearances and beach interactions follow authored rules.
Prepared and directly generated maps agree; snapshot size and hydration speed have separate budgets.
Some mixed tests also pin aesthetic densities or event frequencies rather than direct rules.

groups.title: Campaign identity and map equivalence
groups.reason: Assertions compare identity, stable coast/shape, prepared/direct map equality, allowed species and connectivity. The roster case steps12/24 waves plus20s but only prohibits species outside the roster. It is not a win-rate target. Nearby mapPrep:59 prepared/direct continuation equality is another integrity check, not evidence to move the file. Lead additionally read heightSamples.test.ts:14/31/54: preserved quantized buffers, worker/direct rolling equality, immutable cache and malformed/NaN rejection. Its frozen hash is an extraction-parity baseline, with no later replacing terrain ruling established.

groups.reason: Seven bodies measure generated area-size spread, forest dense/open/gradient shares, type diversity, openness-band tree density, the deliberately reduced-density count, layout-pattern shares and path departure from a straight line. No save/replay/water/exclusion assertion occurs inside these quality-only bodies. These are procedural quality measurements, not seven fight simulations.

rulings: Set-piece supersession: DESIGN.md Ed3Oct says ‘Set pieces are rare bits of scenery’. world-art.md Ed29Oct says ‘phased out of normal generation (setPieceChance0)’ with recipes/art retained for previews. rules.test.ts:1851 asserts setPiecesNear=[] and paths.pieces=[]: retain those replacement guards and split only statistical scenery thresholds. lakes.test.ts:61 conditionally checks returned set-piece positions; mapPrep closure equality does not require one to spawn. No positive old-generation requirement was found in the97 reviewed tests.

Home-growth supersession: journey backlog Ed10/11Oct says first10 areas’ ‘places and their kinds’ remain the same; island.md Ed28Oct says ‘keep the route changing, shuffle the creatures and area types, retain the area shapes’. deal.test.ts:54 requires changed type deals with stable shapes; homeGrowth.test.ts:24 compares cell keys and sorted roster, not type-at-cell. They implement the replacement. The rosters comment saying the night ‘only deals its legends’ is stale explanation, not a reason to delete its count/coast protection.

Placeholder supersession: journey backlog Ed11Oct describes32 kinds and32 placeholders; island.md now says all64 designed. rosters.test.ts:115 still checks64 valid island descriptors; its old placeholder title is stale, while rejecting unknown-01 remains legacy-ID safety. Neither that title nor the64-designed statement proves flora RETHEMING exclusions obsolete.

G3 review limits: floraBiomes.test.ts:31 excludes11 RETHEMING IDs under a comment saying17; an art/data owner must confirm those exclusions. lakeLooks.test.ts:40 returns early if its sampled island has no lake. These are specific coverage-strengthening candidates, not established obsolete whole tests. This bounded review confirmed zero obsolete whole tests.

Timing overlaps: mapPrep, beach, beachDecor, islandGrowth, homeGuard, lakes, island, terrain and win appear in multiple groups. File durations include other tests and other systems. No group-time sum is a wall-time or savings estimate.

Second-pass set-piece evidence: rules.test.ts40–43 explicitly enables setPieceChance=.25, grounds/decor families and path pieces; stoneKeepClear14–16 opts in too. This is retained preview/placement compatibility under the29Oct phase-out, not a positive requirement for normal generation. Keep exclusion/placement rules; report only sampled quality portions.

They receive no automatic keep decision from the world reviewer and remain explicitly unread until an owner/lead review is recorded.

The five maps at 1253 use that TUNING.
